title: Setup navigation: one audit entry, Packages and Installed Apps agree, User Preferences and Identity Links leave the main nav
body:
## Source

Read in the console's Setup app on 2026-10-16 (objectstack `18.0.0-next.1` serving HotCRM; nav from `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup.app.ts` with contributions from `setup-nav.contributions.ts` and `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-plugin.ts`). The sidebar has 43 entries in 9 groups; among them:

- Diagnostics › "Audit Logs" (`sys_audit_log`, a record list with the views Recent / Writes / Auth / 3 more) and "Audit Log Browser" (`component/audit/log`, a filter form over the same rows) show the same data two ways.
- Apps › "Packages" lists HotCRM and HotCRM Service as "Read-only · code" packages; "Installed Apps" says "No marketplace apps installed in this runtime yet" — the two pages disagree about what is installed because one means packages and the other means marketplace installs, and neither says so.
- Advanced › "User Preferences" (`sys_user_preference`: rows `ui.recent`, `ui.favorites`, `ui.flow.palette.recents` per user) and "Identity Links" (`sys_account`: provider ids and user hashes) are internal stores an admin never edits by hand.
- The audit plugin contributes its browser entry whether or not the record list is there.

## Target

1. One audit entry: "Audit Log" opens the browser (filters by action, object, actor, date); the record list's views (Writes, Auth, …) become the browser's presets; the `sys_audit_log` list stays reachable from the browser's "Open as list" link, not from the nav.
2. "Packages" becomes the one place for what is installed: a Source column (code / marketplace / authored) and the marketplace page's install actions; "Installed Apps" retires or becomes a filter preset of Packages. The marketplace entry stays.
3. "User Preferences" and "Identity Links" leave the main navigation; they stay reachable from the User record page (a "Preferences" and an "Identity links" tab) and from the search.
4. The sidebar then has 39 entries; group order unchanged.

## File surface

`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup.app.ts`, `setup-nav.contributions.ts`, `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-plugin.ts` (its nav contribution and `audit-nav-contribution.test.ts`), the `sys_user` record page tabs if they live in platform-objects views, translations.

## Acceptance

1. Tests: the rendered Setup nav has one entry whose target is an audit surface; no top-level entry targets `sys_user_preference` or `sys_account`; Packages' view declares the Source column.
2. The console's Setup sidebar, re-read after the change, matches (the epic PM reads it).
3. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit test` green.

## Constraints

- Objects, routes and record pages stay; only navigation entries and one view column change.

## Evidence

Screenshots on the temporary branch `claude/console-home-login-design-20261016` of objectstack-ai/objectui (commit `01244b886`, never merged): [setup-audit-logs.png](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/01244b886/docs/design/setup-review-2026-10-16/setup-audit-logs.png?raw=true).

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` from the 2026-10-16 second review pass: objectui main `8415d9f11`, HotCRM `63db83e2`, the vite console on :5180 against `objectstack serve --dev` on :4001, the Studio pillars and all 43 Setup pages walked in the maintainer's browser pane at 1024 × 768 (en) with a 1280 × 900 re-check (zh). The maintainer asked for every finding to be filed, verbatim: 「全部立卡」.</sub>
